sequence_prerequisite.policy: ForecastEx census must not execute unless the authoritative Kalshi history closeout on main proves these conditions.

source_contract.pairs_policy: Pairs files are not required to establish census cardinality and are deferred to later PIT/microstructure materialization; they cannot affect semantic inclusion here.

official_ui_semantics.prices: daily closing prices for all events

archive_enumeration.method: Calendar-complete official endpoint enumeration, not current-market scraping.
archive_enumeration.end_date_rule: latest date displayed by the official /data page at execution time
archive_enumeration.date_probe: Request summary first for every UTC calendar date in range. HTTP 200 CSV => archive date exists; HTTP 404 => no official file for that date; other unresolved HTTP/network error fails the census.
archive_enumeration.prices_fetch: For every archive date with a summary file, request the corresponding prices file. Missing prices after its official availability window is recorded as archive incompleteness and fails the census materialization gate.
archive_enumeration.hashing: Record SHA256, byte size, HTTP status, Content-Type and Content-Disposition for every accepted official file.
archive_enumeration.survivorship_policy: No inference from currently visible markets; all official historical dates are enumerated.

semantic_contract.family_rules: Byte-identical family rules and same-mechanism precedence from W4B-SC-v1.0. No ForecastEx-specific family expansion is permitted.
semantic_contract.classification: Exactly one strict frozen family => ACCEPT_STRICT_FAMILY; same-mechanism precedence may resolve overlap; cross-mechanism overlap => AMBIGUOUS; zero families => REJECT.

venue_event_unit.definition: One ForecastEx real-world release/decision occurrence, collapsing Yes/No subtypes and all numeric strike contracts.
venue_event_unit.provisional_key: resolved_family + expiration_date + family-specific macro subject key; for non-macro families use normalized nonnumeric subject text.
venue_event_unit.duplicate_daily_rows: The same event_contract appearing in multiple daily files is one contract observation, never another event.
venue_event_unit.strike_policy: All strikes for the same product/release occurrence are one venue event.

canonicalization.event_reference_date: ForecastEx expiration_date normalized to UTC calendar date for this pre-official-truth stage; missing/unparseable date => CANONICALIZATION_AMBIGUOUS.
canonicalization.macro_subject_key: Use the same family-specific US release key semantics as W4B-SC-v1.0 so same-day Kalshi/ForecastEx aliases can converge on the same signature where they represent the same occurrence.
canonicalization.cross_venue_claim_limit: A matching canonical_event_id is a deterministic candidate duplicate, not final cross-venue truth until the later dedicated dedup stage.

gate.n_claim: ForecastEx accepted canonical counts are venue census capacity only, not N_final_backtestable.
